chunks.title: Profile & Summary
chunks.content: Naser Al Noman is a Computer Science graduate with hands-on Software Quality Assurance experience testing CRM and EMR web applications. He is skilled in manual testing, REST API validation, SQL-based database verification, regression testing, and Playwright test automation. He has experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in Agile environments to deliver high-quality software through frequent release cycles and continuous process improvement.

His LinkedIn profile is at https://www.linkedin.com/in/naser-al-noman and his GitHub is at https://github.com/Naser-Al-Noman. His portfolio website is at https://naseralnoman.vercel.app/. He is based in Mirpur-2, Dhaka-1216, Bangladesh.

chunks.title: SJ Innovation LLC – Software Quality Assurance Engineer (Trainee)
chunks.content: Naser worked as a Software Quality Assurance Engineer (Trainee) at SJ Innovation LLC from March 2026 to July 2026, based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He designed and executed manual test cases while supporting regression, smoke, and release validation for frequent software deployments. He performed REST API testing using Postman, validated backend business logic, and verified database integrity using SQL. He identified, documented, and tracked defects in JIRA, collaborating closely with developers to ensure timely resolution and high software quality. He investigated application issues using API responses, browser developer tools, and application logs. He automated end-to-end test scenarios using Playwright to reduce repetitive manual testing efforts. He collaborated with developers, QA engineers, and product stakeholders to clarify requirements and improve software quality. He was nominated as Performer of the Month for contributions in the CRM project.

chunks.title: SJ Innovation LLC – Software Quality Assurance Engineer (Internship)
chunks.content: Naser worked as a Software Quality Assurance Engineer (Internship) at SJ Innovation LLC from November 2025 to March 2026, based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He assisted in executing manual test cases for web-based applications. He supported the identification, documentation, and reporting of software defects. He collaborated with QA engineers and developers throughout the software testing lifecycle. He was nominated as Performer of the Month for contributions in the EMR project.

chunks.title: Mongol Tori – Research & Documentation, AI & Autonomous Subteam
chunks.content: Naser worked in the Research & Documentation role on the AI & Autonomous Subteam at Mongol Tori from October 2022 to December 2024, based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He contributed to test planning and validation of AI models and autonomous navigation logic, identifying performance issues and documenting test outcomes. He collected and analyzed performance data from rover sensors to improve autonomous navigation. He implemented data-driven decision logic using Python and ROS for object detection, and maintained versioned datasets and documented insights for the research team.

chunks.title: BRACU Express – Sports Journalist & Editor
chunks.content: Naser worked as a Sports Journalist & Editor at BRACU Express from June 2021 to November 2023, based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He conducted interviews and gathered qualitative data for publication, enhancing reporting accuracy. He analyzed readership trends using Excel to track article engagement metrics, and collaborated with a diverse editorial team, developing strong communication and presentation skills for client-facing tasks.

chunks.title: Technical Skills
chunks.content: Programming: Python, JavaScript. Software Testing: Manual Testing, Functional Testing, Regression Testing, Smoke Testing, BDD (Gherkin), Integration Testing, REST API Testing, End-to-End Testing, Test Case Design. Testing Tools: Playwright, Postman, JIRA, Selenium, Cypress, JMeter. Database: MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, SQL Querying, Data Validation. Development Tools: Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, VS Code. Methodologies: Agile (Scrum, Kanban), Bug Tracking, Test Documentation. Other: LaTeX, Arduino.

chunks.title: Education
chunks.content: Naser Al Noman completed his Bachelor of Science in Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) from BRAC University, Dhaka, Bangladesh, from June 2021 to October 2025, graduating with a CGPA of 3.51. Prior to that, he completed his Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) at Mirpur Cantonment Public School & College from July 2018 to December 2020, achieving a GPA of 5.00.

chunks.title: Achievements
chunks.content: Naser's achievements include: 1st Runner Up at the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2022 (Dhaka Region), where he built a web-based space data visualization platform displaying stellar variability and 3D planetary models using real scientific datasets; 3rd place in the Math Olympiad at BAGHC in 2017; 3rd place in the Science Project competition at BAGHC in 2017; nominated as Performer of the Month at SJ Innovation LLC during both his internship (EMR project) and trainee period (CRM project).

chunks.title: Personal & Academic Projects
chunks.content: 1. API Automation Platform (React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Newman, Postman): Full-stack platform for automating REST API tests with Postman collections and Newman. Upload collections and environments, run tests from the UI or CI, validate responses with JSON Schema, review HTML reports, and monitor pass-rate and performance trends. GitHub: https://github.com/Naser-Al-Noman/API-Automation-Platform. Live demo: https://api-automation-platform-weld.vercel.app/. 2. AI Test Case Generator (Python, Streamlit, Google Gemini, Pandas): Streamlit app that turns software requirements and user stories into structured test cases using the Google Gemini API. Review results in a table and export them as CSV or Excel. GitHub: https://github.com/Naser-Al-Noman/Ai-Test-Case-Generator. Live demo: https://ai-test-case-generator1.streamlit.app/. 3. QA Analytics Dashboard (Python, Streamlit, Pandas, Plotly): Data-source agnostic QA analytics dashboard for test execution and defect metrics. Upload CSV, JSON, or Excel results to explore KPIs, flaky tests, severity trends, and failure-to-defect correlation charts. GitHub: https://github.com/Naser-Al-Noman/qa-dashboard. Live demo: https://dashboardfortest.streamlit.app/. 4. Blood Donation Services (Python, Flask, SQLite, Cryptography): Flask platform for blood donation requests, donor discovery by blood group and area, and donation campaigns. Sensitive data is encrypted at rest with hashed passwords and integrity checks. GitHub: https://github.com/Naser-Al-Noman/bloodservices. Live demo: https://bloodaid-2wfk.onrender.com/.
